reviews.text:
Ramiscone is a bakery that combines delicious gluten-free breads, a restaurant with a nice atmosphere, and a hip neighborhood called Ikseon-dong (as of 2024). Bread and biscuits are displayed around the window so you can see them from outside. In the meantime, I have tried scones in over 200 bakeries in five cities and countries, but based on my taste buds, Ramis Cones is so delicious that it can be considered the best scone restaurant of my life. If I had to find fault with it, there are three things. Because it is famous and delicious, it takes some time on weekends to find a place to sit and buy bread or drinks. And the bathroom here is not very modern, perhaps because it was renovated from an old Hanok house. Lastly, I was disappointed that the coffee couldn't match the taste of the bread.

For more information:
- Service: It's average. Neither very friendly nor unfriendly, just somewhere in the middle.
- Price: It is a medium price, but I feel it is not bad value for money.
- Taste: Ramis cone breads are said to be made with health in mind, but I'm not sure about that (if you care about your health, you should refrain from eating the bread itself), but I liked it because it wasn't too sweet and was soft without the hardness of a typical scone. In particular, looking at the fact that the bread is not dry even though it is displayed in a glass-enclosed store built like a greenhouse, I wonder if bread that is sold out quickly and older than a day is discarded (in the United States and Europe, there are many places that keep it on display for 2-3 days).
- Parking: Because it is a narrow alley in Ikseon-dong, you must use the nearby public parking lot.
- Restroom: There is one, but it doesn’t fit well with the atmosphere of the bakery.

reviews.text: It’s truly a blessing to have such a delicious bakery in Ikseon-dong. The cream cheese sweet pumpkin ciabatta and campagne were really delicious. I will go often when I stop by Ikseon-dong.

reviews.author: Amazing Grace Rice Ball
reviews.text: It is a quiet Hanok teahouse full of traditional beauty. The taste of the hangwa here is great, but more than anything, the packaging is really thoughtful and luxurious (even though it's expensive... haha). I prepared it as a gift by putting it in a pretty box, and the recipient loved it, saying it made him feel like he was receiving special treatment. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a quality gift!

reviews.author: Eden Kim
reviews.text: It's rare to find a place that sells Kaesong Juak, so I went in to buy it as soon as I found it while passing by :) You could call it a traditional Korean chewy cookie haha. It's chewy on the outside and inside. The price of Juak in Dubai is not as high as other Dubai menu items. Instead, you can think of it as just a chocolate Juak with a little pistachio flavor rather than the taste of Dujokku! I liked the Dubai flavor better than the original. The price was affordable for a gift, and most of all, the staff was friendly.

reviews.author: Rodrigo John
reviews.text:
As you walk through the alleys of Jongno, Silla Dang, which has the atmosphere of a luxurious dessert shop, catches your eye.
This is the first time I have seen a place where Juak, a traditional Korean snack, is made so sophisticatedly.

The juak made in-house is neatly displayed, and the colors are so pretty.
The outside was shiny and chewy, and the inside had a savory taste without being too sweet.
In particular, the matcha green tea and Schisandra chinensis had a subtle scent and a unique flavor that lingered in your mouth.

The price is 3,400 won per piece, but considering the taste and quality, it is not a waste at all.
It feels like a modern reinterpretation of a traditional dessert, so I highly recommend it as a gift 🎁

I liked that the inside of the cafe was clean and warm, and the yakgwa that came out as part of the review event was also delicious!

reviews.author: Seoha Yi
reviews.text:
As the name suggests, this is not a cafe with a lot of plants.
The seats next to the counter have a better atmosphere…

event? The draft beer (ale) and snacks available are delicious.

reviews.author: Taste Log
reviews.text:
I visited because it had a high Google review score.
The interior was decorated in a variety of ways and tastefully, making me feel like I was in another time and space.

The space itself was charming and lovely.

However, the taste of crople was somewhat ordinary compared to its appearance.

It was nice that they had a variety of black teas and that they were beautifully plated.

However, the price range is somewhat high.

I think it will be a good cafe option for those visiting Ikseon-dong.

reviews.author: Blue Wine
reviews.text:
The moment you enter the cafe, the interior is divided into two parts and feels different. The left side of the entrance feels like a hanok, and the right side feels like a pretty cafe. I took a seat in a place on the left that felt like a hanok, and it was cozy and nice.

The inside of the cafe was larger than expected, and the atmosphere felt warm. The hanok atmosphere of Ikseon-dong and the modern cafe atmosphere were harmoniously combined.

The Hanok-style corner, which gives a special sense of space, created a cozy and warm atmosphere. You can even feel the old-fashioned magnetic field.

The drinks are soso

reviews.author: h hhhkk
reviews.text: While walking down an alley in Ikseon-dong, I went into ‘Cafe Plant’ to get out of the rain. The atmosphere was really nice. As soon as I opened the door, it was full of green plants, so even though it was in the middle of the city, the air felt different. I sat by the window and drank coffee while listening to the sound of rain, and for no reason, I felt calm and comfortable. ☕️ The staff were also naturally friendly, which made it even better. It’s a place where you want to stay for a long time. I plan to play with my friends again next time :)

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
It looks like a takeout restaurant, but you can have coffee and dessert at the bar table.  The owner was very friendly and we had a nice chat.
Makgeolli gelato was also unique.

reviews.author: Yujeong Lee
reviews.text:
I like bagels, so I've tried them a lot here and there, but this place has really solid basics.
The outside is chewy and slightly crispy, and the inside is moist, so the more you chew it, the more delicious it becomes. It had just the right texture without the chewy feeling typical of bagels, so it was easy to eat without any pressure👍🏻

reviews.author: shale ah
reviews.text:
It was rewarding to go on an open run early in the morning ☀️
The bagel was so delicious that it was not worth the wait. The moment I took a bite, the outside was chewy and crispy, and the inside was moist and soft, so I kept reaching for it. The wheat scent was fragrant and I could feel that each ingredient was made with care.

Each type had its own personality, so it was fun to choose, and more than anything, it felt warm and fresh, perhaps because it had just come out. Encountering such a pleasant taste in the morning made me feel like my day would go better for no reason.

I immediately understood why everyone was holding an open run, and I definitely want to come back next time. If you like bagels, I recommend you try it at least once 🥯✨

reviews.author: sumin
reviews.text:
The London Bagel Anguk Branch I was curious about!
This time I finally visited. The atmosphere of the store is really pretty and there are a variety of bagels to choose from, so it was fun to choose.

I haven't tried it yet, but just looking at the visuals gives me great expectations. I feel like I know why everyone is waiting in line to eat... !

reviews.author: SOMAN AHN
reviews.text: I visited a local Dubai chocolate bagel restaurant! There’s a reason it’s so popular!  Other bagels are also delicious 💜 The blueberry bagels and cookies and cookies are delicious, and the sandwich bagels are also delicious for meals. I recommend them.

reviews.author: Minji Kim
reviews.text: I came here because I heard the Strawberry Blossom and Dubai Chocolate Bagels were delicious! Other than that, I recommend it if you want to try delicious sandwich bagels and all kinds of bagels hahaha they are delicious as well.

address: 2nd floor, 15 Gyedong-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: sumin
reviews.text: There are so many delicious looking breads that it’s hard to choose! As soon as I entered the store, my expectations rose. I haven't tried it yet, but I think I understand why it's famous. I can’t wait to try it!

reviews.author: Ashley Jang
reviews.text:
It's a fairly large and exotic stand-alone building, so it's easy to spot, and there are so many different types of bakeries that it's a treat just to look at it.
However, compared to the variety of breads, there were fewer drinks, and the taste of the bread was not as good as expected.
Still, it's not too crowded and it's clean, so it looks like a good place to take a break while walking around Bukchon Hanok Village.

reviews.author: Sunghyuk Park
reviews.text:
I usually drink espresso, but it was so hot that I ordered the granita and it was really delicious. The visual, reminiscent of the Italian flag in red, white and green, was pretty, cool and refreshing.
The grappa topped with white sugar powder was also chewy and went well with it. The cornetti was also moist and delicious on the outside.
Perhaps because I visited early (10 a.m.), the store was quiet and I was able to enjoy it leisurely.

I recommend it because the drinks and bakery are of good quality and the atmosphere is great!

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
This is a place that sells Italian bread, but not all the bread seems to be Italian. Still, since I had just been to Italy, I went there expecting to taste the food I had there, and it wasn't bad and delicious.
I actually liked the unique Italian bread taste that wasn't too dessert-like.
The bread itself was quite delicious and the quality wasn't bad, but the price was quite expensive... It's a place worth experiencing, but the price is high so it's probably hard to visit often.
Still, it's worth a visit because they sell Italian bread that is hard to find in Korea. There are many different types of bread, so it's definitely fun to choose and eat them.
The store is quite spacious, so you can enjoy it leisurely, and the brunch is also good.

reviews.author: Strawberry shaved ice
reviews.text:
Because it was a weekday, I was able to enjoy coffee and bread quietly. The pizza served on a plate for one person was served warm when you paid and it was very delicious. I wanted to try the lemon candy and the brunch menu later.
There are plenty of seats and plenty of space, so I think I'll use it occasionally.

Crunchy, moist and delicious at a reasonable price
Emmental cheese crople is the classic sweet and salty dish.

reviews.author: Varissara Nattapattana
reviews.text: It's a small stall, takeout only and no seating, but both waffles and croples are delicious 😋🧇 The original crople boasts just the right amount of sweetness with the crunchy sugar scent added to the chewy and soft bread. Almond Crofle is full of almonds, crunchy and has a perfect taste. It's about 3,000 won/3,200 won each 🥜

reviews.author: هذا رايي فقط
reviews.text: To be honest, I had to wait in line for about 30 minutes. I think most people come to take pictures. 😀 There are various types of croissants, including fig, strawberry, grape, and plain, and they are all really delicious. There are other pastries too, but you have to be careful because they contain meat or lard. This is especially true for pies that come in the shape of pizza. The coffee was honestly not that good. The cafe atmosphere was nice and the seats were nice, but the music was a bit annoying. The prices are reasonable, like other cities.

reviews.author: Heather Sinclair
reviews.text: Street waffle stand. There are so many different types of waffles. One downside is that the waffles are too crispy. They have to be a bit hard to carry around, and they are not Belgian breakfast waffles. Still, it's a bit stiff. The taste is good.

reviews.author: Low Key
reviews.text: The waffles (or are they croffles?) are crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, and not too sweet, making this a place worth stopping by.

reviews.author: pea
reviews.text: Bukchon Organic Red Bean Bread, located near Anguk Station. There are breads of various flavors, including small-sized original red bean bread and cream cheese bread. The original red bean bread I purchased is good to eat in moderation with the bean paste and bread.

reviews.author: Jihyun Han
reviews.text: I enjoyed the sweet red bean paste bread and pea bean paste bread.

reviews.author: Cindy Kim
reviews.text: There aren't many bakeries right near Anguk Station, so I went there often, but I don't know if the lady at the counter is the owner or her part-timer, but her attitude is unpleasant. Let's be polite and kind at a minimum.

reviews.author: oil pill
reviews.text: It's unfriendly. I remember eating it at the Apgujeong branch and it was delicious. When I finished graduate school and wore sweats, my part-timer didn't even say hello to me on a weekday evening, but the office worker in a suit greeted me. It's unpleasant.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
A place called a scone restaurant.
I believe it is the same company as the London Bagel Museum.
Maybe that's why the store atmosphere is strangely similar.
The boss seems to really like England. You can also see the Union Jack here.
Because it was late, there weren't many menu items, but there were quite a few different types of scones.
Scones are the best bread to eat with coffee.
It was nice to have the right texture and savory taste. However, it is not a unique taste.
It just feels like a well-made dessert.
However, the price is somewhat high.
The store is pretty, so it seems like a better option to enjoy your leisure time eating in the store rather than taking out.

reviews.author: Soul Catherine
reviews.text: I went to this cafe while taking a walk around Bukchon, and it's a great scone restaurant. Since I visited late in the afternoon, the quantity was small, but I packed it up and ate it at the hotel just to taste it. The visual design of the various ingredients makes the menus look appetizing and attract a lot of attention. I ate mainly the best menu and it was delicious. They packed a lot of cakes with a reservation. It's a great scone place to stop by and have a cool drink and a light dessert while passing by.

reviews.author: Tori Kim
reviews.text:
The inside is so pretty and the atmosphere is great!

I think the fresh flowers and pretty scones on display make you want to pass by and come in.

The taste of the scones is actually ok, but since there aren't many places that sell scones in Korea, I think this is a cafe that people who like scones want to visit from time to time.

Still, it was nice to have a variety of flavors and the taste of the coffee was better than I expected.

In particular, the staff were very friendly (unlike these days), so I felt good. I hope kindness is also Ryo’s operating philosophy..~

Perhaps because it is a location with many foreigners, there are staff who speak English and Japanese, so I think it would be good to recommend it to foreigners.

However, I think the price of the scones is a bit expensive.

Still, if I think of scones, I think I'll go straight for layering.

reviews.author: Just_2
reviews.text:
Layered Anguk Branch, a café where scones are the main character.

I went to Layered, a cafe recommended by someone who lives in Seoul.
It opens at 8 am and I visited to enjoy morning coffee and scones, but there were a lot of people even though it was in the morning. Most of them were foreigners.
The overall atmosphere of the store is cute.
I ordered a strawberry scone, apple jam cinnamon scone, and iced Americano.
The apple jam cinnamon scone was really delicious.
The plain scone itself was delicious, but it was fun to eat it with jam and butter added to it.

reviews.author: Na Young Park
reviews.text: The cake melts in your mouth. There are many Japanese customers in the store. The staff are also friendly and responsive.

reviews.author: Heo Ji-ah
reviews.text: I went out for a walk in Bukchon and stopped by the very famous Zaiso. There were a lot of foreigners and the packaging was so cute ♡ I need to eat there soon and come back again.

reviews.author: Chu Hye-yoon
reviews.text: You can see the rice cake being made in person, and rather than describing it as a pretty rice cake, I want to talk about it because it is a small and pretty work of art. The sales people are friendly and the atmosphere inside is very nice. I want to come again next time♡ Sell a lot ^-^

reviews.author: Su
reviews.text:
I like glutinous rice cakes, so I eat them every time I see a store.
It was so delicious that I could taste it with my hands!
Next time, I want to try other flavors besides strawberry!

reviews.author: Mihee Han
reviews.text: I think the front of the Jaiso Anguk branch is a fall spot.. The store was so pretty that I took a picture, and it was so pretty.. The rice cakes were so pretty, and I fell in love with the delicious rice cakes... I bought the rice cakes because they were so pretty, and they even tasted great..

reviews.author: Insang Kauh
reviews.text: If you put your sincerity into it, even glutinous rice cake can become a work of art. It's such a famous place that it doesn't need any explanation, but it's delicious and pretty.  It's an Instagramable place.

reviews.author: Nicole Ong
reviews.text:
Paper & Cup is a really cozy and simple cafe located on the street right in front of Exit 2 of Anguk Station. I stopped by for a quick breakfast while waiting for a friend, and ended up tasting the best coffee of my life! 🥹 Even though I don’t usually enjoy drinking coffee!

I ordered Honey Almond Milk Coffee (₩7,000) and it was so delicious that I saved it for my friend to try too. The bottle was so cute~ I also bought a lemon curd cupcake (₩5,800), which was just the snack I was looking for!

reviews.author: Okazaki Kanako
reviews.text:
I am very satisfied so I recommend it.
After opening at 9:30 in the morning, customers came in one after another and the restaurant was almost full.
Pumpkin muffins are delicious because they have a rich yellow color on top and cream on the inside.
I ordered a white coffee with the same name, but it was very delicious because it had a sweet white flavor mixed in with the strong flavor of espresso.

reviews.author: Abraham Lee
reviews.text: It was a really cozy cafe with delicious coffee and surprisingly delicious cupcakes. I had an iced Americano (Ethiopian blend), and it was really soft and fragrant. The lemon curd cupcakes were tart yet not too sweet, so they went well with coffee. It was an unexpected discovery. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Adnan Abbas
reviews.text: It was the best coffee I've ever had in my life. It was coffee brewed using an Ethiopian AeroPress. If you like coffee with a strong fruity flavor, be sure to try it.

reviews.author: 渋谷家
reviews.text: The cupcakes, the atmosphere of the store, and the clerk are also very cute. Iced coffee and hot coffee are both delicious. Healed~.

reviews.author: Gachirun Branding Therapy
reviews.text:
I went to Bukchon to get some fresh air and stopped by the London Bagel Museum near Exit 2 of Anguk Station. I absolutely hate waiting in line, so I gave up and turned around, but my husband set up a wait list using the Catch Table app, so I took a long walk around Bukchon Road and looked around, so the timing was right. They informed us that there would be a 70-minute wait for eating inside and 90 minutes for take-out, but it was disappointing that the menu was almost sold out as it was close to dinner.
I didn't have all the bagels I liked, so I substituted today's soup, and I thought, "This is a great soup restaurant!!" I enjoyed it so much that I was amazed.
From the entrance to ordering to serving on the second floor, the staff were all calm but pleasantly friendly, so I had a pleasant experience even though there was a long wait + there was no choice as the menu was sold out.

reviews.author: Philosophizing
reviews.text:
The waiting line has gotten shorter recently...!
The plain bagels are really chewy and delicious,
The green onion cream cheese served together was excellent!
Overall, the price is expensive, but...TT
This is a place where you can get a decent light meal near Anguk Station~~

reviews.author: Soul Catherine
reviews.text: I have an accommodation near Gwanghwamun, so I arrived right at opening time to eat breakfast, but the line was absolutely ridiculous. There were mostly Japanese people, so the staff even gave directions in Japanese. It took about 30-40 minutes to go in, choose, and pack, but there was a wait~ Then we packed and ate it at the hotel, and the sandwiches were delicious. If you visit in the afternoon, they are sold out and there is no bread, so I recommend visiting in the morning.

reviews.author: Ji young Yoon (Cooky Yoon)
reviews.text: Even on weekends and weekdays, if you go around 6 o'clock, all the bread is gone and there is almost nothing haha 😂 Still, I picked up the leftovers because I wanted to eat them while they were still warm. I picked up two bagels, a truffle butter bagel and a sausage jalapeno bagel. Tourists also lined up to pick it up. There is not a lot of waiting for takeout customers at this time (but it is sold out...) The maple pecan cream that is listed as the best is delicious. Hope to get more bread next time... 🍀🥯

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
Revisit after 3 years. I didn't plan on visiting because the wait was always long, but the wait seems to have decreased a bit recently.
There are still a lot of people, but the line fills up quickly.
There are still various types of bagels, and I like dessert-type bagels, but bagel sandwiches are also good.
I think it's okay to buy a sandwich and eat it instead of a meal.
It's a bagel that's very soft and has a decent taste.
It must have been difficult for the staff because there were so many people, but it was nice to be greeted with a smile.

reviews.author: cheon choi
reviews.text:
As rumored, it is a cost-effective bakery.
The salt bread was delicious and other types of bread in general.
It was delicious. I was lucky and didn't have to wait.
If you want to eat inside, you must order one drink.

reviews.author: I like the new road SSu
reviews.text:
I have to stop by when I go to Anguk-dong and saved this place.
I thought it was a small bakery, but there is a tea room and the bread prices are very good value for money. And the taste is really great. I especially recommend the olive ciatta and green tea cream bread.
Also, I only saw the two types of cakes on display, but the price of 19,000 won is a real treat. I think it would be a great gift for Christmas
What's unusual is that admission is restricted to reduce crowding. You can only purchase one meal or takeout while waiting, so repurchase is not possible. This is probably to reduce crowding in the store.
Nevertheless, 100% intention to revisit

There were a few pieces of bread missing when I entered, but when I left after eating for about an hour, almost all of them were sold out even though it was just before 4 o'clock.

reviews.author: Choi Sam
reviews.text: This is a good value bread restaurant. There are a variety of breads and the coffee is delicious. You have to register at the catch table at the entrance by selecting takeout or in-store use and wait a bit. It's a house worth waiting for~

reviews.author: Bart Chang
reviews.text: Wow...this is the only bakery that offers both quantity and taste for less than 4,000 won. There is no comparison with the houses next door.

reviews.author: tabi neko
reviews.text: The salt bread I was hoping for didn't have the feel of a kwajajak, but something of a sticky texture. Among the salt bread, scones, chicken breast banh mi, and baguettes, the baguette was the best. You must order a drink when eating at the restaurant, but the drinks are expensive. I'd like to pay a little more and get some delicious bread... I won't be visiting again.

address: 2nd floor, 50 Gyedong-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Flamingo
reviews.text:

Recently, a series of cafes have opened next to it and hot stores are located in Bukchon Alley, but if you listen to the story, it is said that in the past, there was only one cafe on this street. When you actually go there, you can feel the weight of time. It doesn't feel dirty or worn, but rather in the form of elegance that has been carefully maintained.
In fact, I'm going to end this introduction to the space, which is an area I don't know much about, but what I really want to emphasize is that the sandwiches here are really, really delicious. My favorite is the egg bacon sandwich, which costs 4,000 won. It has plenty of bacon, eggs, tomato sauce, and jalapenos for a kick in a well-toasted bread, and it tastes great. It feels and feels like it was made at home, but it also has technical details that are difficult to imitate at home. I also think that it is excellent value for money.
Of course, other sandwiches are delicious, and coffee lovers around me say that the coffee and drinks are delicious, so I think it's a store worth checking out.

reviews.author: Eungjo Kim
reviews.text:
This is a pancake specialty store located at the entrance to Insa-dong. You can order pancakes and drinks on the second floor of the cafe and enjoy them at your seats on the second and third floors. All the coffee, tea, and pancakes on the menu all taste good.

I think this place is one of the best pancake restaurants in Korea. When you order tea, they provide enough tea for 2-3 people, and I think it goes well with pancakes. Tijan was also given according to the number of people visiting.

The restrooms are clean and have separate floors for men and women, and there is no separate parking lot.

reviews.author: Jongsu Kim
reviews.text:
A place where four best friends met in Insa-dong, had dinner (at a nobleman's house), and then went for coffee.
At first, I wanted to go to Starbucks, a common coffee shop, but it was full, so I looked around and found a cafe.
The location of this place is on the second floor on the right after passing Starbucks when you go towards Tapgol Park based on Gugu Gallery on Insadong-gil.
(Address: 146, Insa-dong, Jongno-gu, 2nd floor)
When you open the wooden glass door and enter, you will immediately see stairs leading up to the 2nd/3rd floor.
When I went up the stairs, there was a counter on the second floor and a table by the window and past the stairs. There were customers near the window.
The stairs seemed inconvenient since they were next to the counter, so I went up to the 3rd floor.
The 3rd floor was spacious, but there were no windows, so it felt a bit stuffy.
The entire store had a classic and dignified feel with wooden walls and wooden tables, and it was nice that it wasn't noisy and cluttered like Starbucks.
Later, through an internet search, I found out that it was a great dessert restaurant and the pancakes and scones were especially delicious...
We were full after dinner.
I ordered Americano (H/I: same price 5,300 won).
The coffee tastes good because it is roasted well.
I could feel the deep taste of the exquisite combination of burnt, bitter, sour, and sweet.
The amount of coffee is M size.
Does the coffee cup have a ceramic feel like a cafe in Insa-dong? Haha
Because we were talking among men, we couldn't fully enjoy the taste of coffee.
All of the desserts seemed small and expensive, but I wanted to try the pancakes.
(I couldn’t take a few pictures because I was having a conversation)

reviews.text:
Operated by Missha? Ungnyeo’s temple.
It was very enjoyable, including the cave reminiscent of the bear Ungnyeo from Dangun myth, mugwort drink and mugwort dessert, mugwort mysk, the sound of water falling, and media art like an exhibition.
However, the space is very small (only 5 tables), so we went on a public holiday and there were 13 teams in front of us, so we were able to look around for about 2 hours, eat, and then go in. If you go, I recommend going early or late. And it's definitely less crowded on weekdays. The design is really unique and the drinks are also average. The macarons are also delicious. I like the red bean paste + mugwort filling.

reviews.text:
It’s a small two-story cafe in Insa-dong.
If you go from Nakwon Shopping Center towards Insa-dong, you will see a dark green building on the left. (Opposite the Coffee Bean)

Cafe Latte 5,500

The dark green color catches your eye at a glance on a slightly drab(?) street. When you open the cafe door and enter, the aroma of coffee greets you before the owner greets you. I really like it. :)
The inside of the store is a mess. As soon as the guest leaves, the place is cleaned up. There are three or four tables on the second floor. The view of Insa-dong from the full-length window is nice.
The scent of coffee wafting in the air and the classical melody go very well together.
It was nice to be able to enjoy a quiet Saturday morning with coffee and music. If it becomes more known, it seems like this quietness will be taken away... Still, it’s good to share good things, right? ^^

Today’s coffee is 4,500 won. It is said that it falls 4 times a day.
Coffee is delicious. Latte has a good balance with milk. I'll have to try Americano next time.
